# Hertfordshire Climbing Club

> A friendly group of local climbers in Hertfordshire, United Kingdom.

## Key information

- Regular meet: usually every Thursday at around 8pm.
- Meeting place: Hertfordshire Sports Village climbing wall.
- Official website: https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/

## Pages

- [Home](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/): A short description of the club.
- [Sessions](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/sessions): Meeting time and location.
- [Join us](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/join): How to meet and join the club.
